thread:
mia_cs: Heads up — ACME reported month-end invoice for Feb is $3,220 but their dashboard shows $2,770. Customer says the extra ~450 tokens are unexplained. They need a reconciliation before Monday.
jonah_support: Thanks Mia. Can you drop the acct_id + invoice_id? Also do we have the aggregate job run times around cutoff?
mia_cs: acct: acct_00987, invoice: inv_2026_02_28_00987. They pasted a PDF link (private). Said dashboard totals were stable until 00:05 UTC on 2026-03-01 then invoice already generated.
dana_engineer: Pulling logs. Quick checks to run: 1) billing.aggregate run time for 2026-02-28 partition 2) any backfill jobs touching that partition after invoice generation 3) plan mapping lookups.
deepa_billing: I already see billing-pipeline logs showing a backfill at 2026-03-01T00:12:17Z that touched partition 2026-02-28. Could be late ingest.
billing-bot: job billing-aggregate-2026-02-28 completed at 2026-03-01T00:00:50Z (aggregated tokens: 2770).
billing-bot: job backfill-rows-2026-02-28 completed at 2026-03-01T00:12:17Z (delta_tokens: +452).
jonah_support: That backfill delta matches the diff. Do we know why rows arrived late? Any consumer failures or retry spikes?
dana_engineer: Looking at ingestion logs — there was a midnight embed-worker retry storm from a batch that had timestamp conversion bug in v2 client. It retried at 00:09Z and ingested old events stamped 2026-02-28 which we then backfilled.
mia_cs: So invoice generated between the two jobs and didn't include backfill — customer got charged for the late rows?
sam_finance: If invoice was finalized before backfill, we need to credit or issue an adjusted invoice. How many dollars roughly for 452 tokens? (this is float-level)
deepa_billing: Estimate: 452 tokens * $0.10 per 1k tokens roughly -> $0.0452. Hmm that seems small. I think tokens are actually token-units (embedding units) in their plan; need exact rate. My rough calc doesn't match $450. Wait maybe these deltas are in token-units scaled (we store micro-units). I'll run the convert.
dana_engineer: Reproducing aggregation locally — run this query on the billing-repro cluster (replace acct id):

```
SELECT acct_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum, plan_id
FROM billing.events
WHERE acct_id = 'acct_00987' AND event_time >= '2026-02-01' AND event_time < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY acct_id, plan_id;
```

Result on master snapshot (before backfill): tokens_sum = 2770. After applying backfill rows from staging files tokens_sum = 3222. Backfill inserted 452 tokens and changed plan_id for ~120 tokens (they were previously unclassified and defaulted to 'standard' but backfill mapped to 'pro').
jonah_support: That plan reclassification could cause a per-token rate difference explaining larger $ impact. Deepa, can you confirm rate lookup for 'pro' vs 'standard' for this account's billing cycle?
deepa_billing: Confirmed — acct_00987 was on 'Pro-2025' plan (rate 0.12 per 1k tokens) but the backfilled rows mapped to 'Enterprise-legacy' (rate 0.95 per 1k tokens) because plan_mappings table had a late entry (created 2026-03-01T00:05:00Z). So the late mapping caused those tokens to be billed at higher tier on invoice generation.
sam_finance: That explains the $450-ish delta. So root causes: 1) midnight embed-worker retry storm injecting late events 2) plan_mappings change timing caused misclassification 3) invoice snapshot happened before backfill but used mapping state at invoice time (we snapshot pricing differently).
dana_engineer: Short-term mitigation options: A) issue manual credit for delta and close; B) reissue corrected invoice (needs customer consent + accounting ops); C) adjust pipeline to hold invoice finalization for X minutes when backfills detected.
mia_cs: ACME wants a clear explanation and either a corrected invoice or credit. They prefer an adjusted invoice.
jonah_support: Action items: - Deepa to compute exact dollar delta and create credit/invoice adjustment draft - Dana to add detection rule: if backfill touches recently-finalized partition -> flag and pause invoice finalization for 15m - Mia to draft customer-facing explanation and next steps - Sam to approve accounting treatment.
deepa_billing: I'll run convert and attach exact numbers. Current quick calc: delta_tokens 452, of which 120 classified to Enterprise-legacy. Rough charge delta = $452.12 (confirming shortly).
billing-bot: ticket BLG-452 created for invoice adjustment (linked to inv_2026_02_28_00987).
sam_finance: Approve credit flow if < $5k and customer agrees. Will sign off on adjusted invoice.
mia_cs: I'll reach out to ACME now with proposed timeline: adjusted invoice within 48 hours or credit if they prefer.
dana_engineer: Tech follow-up: pushing a small patch to embed-worker client to fix timestamp conversion and adding a granularity check to ingestion (reject future-dated retries beyond 5m). PR #5982 opened.
\onjona_support: Thanks everyone. Once Deepa posts final numbers I'll update the ticket and Mia will send customer copy. :thumbsup:
mia_cs: leaving a short note for record: root cause = late ingest + plan mapping race at cutoff. Will close once invoice adjusted.
